name: 05201 · Bennington, VT
findings: ZIP 05201 (Bennington) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 05201 (Bennington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 05201 (Bennington) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 05201 (Bennington) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
